crossRefs.note: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have…
“Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say…
“Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by…
“Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can…
“For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest…
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! For…
Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice. “Therefore the curse…
Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be…

translations.web: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Why do you bring a case against Me? You have all rebelled against Me,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Wherefore will ye contend with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith Jehovah.
